test_policy.notes: Murray State calls its process test-optional: freshmen with an unweighted high school GPA of 2.75 or higher are admitted, and 2.0-2.74 gets holistic review. International applicants need a high school GPA of at least 2.0 and English proof; an SAT total of 960 is one of the accepted English proofs.

requirements.notes: International application fee is $100 online ($200 if applying for conditional admission through the ESL program); domestic freshmen pay $40. Required uploads: passport, high school transcripts (GPA 2.0+) with certified translation, graduation certificate, bank statement of at least $30,706 or a scholarship letter, and English proof. Common App use not confirmed on the pages read.

deadlines.label: International bachelor's application deadline, Fall 2027 (August intake)
deadlines.notes: From the international application page, which lists the Fall 2027 intake explicitly. Spring 2027 (January intake): Nov. 15. Transfer students already in the US: July 20 for fall.

deadlines.label: General Scholarship Application deadline (competitive scholarships)
deadlines.notes: Competitive scholarships are open to all students and require admission first. The first-year Academic Achievement scholarships and the Presidential Fellowship (Dec. 1, 2026 deadline) are stated as available only to domestic students.

english_policy.waiver_notes: English proof is not required from citizens of the listed English-speaking countries or from graduates of a US high school; it is also met by admission to or completion of Murray State's ESL program, five O-level passes (GCE/GCSE/IGCSE/AICE/HIGCSE) or Cambridge English B2+, or one full-time semester (12+ credits) at a US institution with a 2.5 GPA. Accepted tests (full admission / admission with condition): IELTS 6.0 / 5.5, TOEFL iBT 71 / 61, SAT 960, GTEC 1190 / 1100, PTE 51 / 45, Duolingo 100 / 90, TOEIC 790 / 700, Kaplan Advanced / Higher Intermediate. Admitted with condition means undergraduates must keep a 2.0 GPA in the first semester. Applicants below those scores can apply for conditional admission starting in the ESL program.

english.notes: 71 = standard requirement; 61 = full admission with condition (2.0 GPA in the first semester). The page gives no 1-6 scale scores. The older FAQ page says a TOEFL of 60 or less, or an IELTS of 5.0, leads to ESL conditional admission.
100 or higher = standard; 90 = admission with condition.
Page accepts a level of B2 or higher on the Cambridge English exam (or five O-level subject passes on GCE/GCSE/IGCSE/AICE/HIGCSE); no numeric score is printed.

aid.notes: From the Common Data Set: only the college's own non-need-based aid for nonresidents. The first-year Academic Achievement scholarships ($1,000-$10,000, by GPA) and the Presidential Fellowship are domestic-only. International students can compete for general competitive scholarships after admission, and first-time transfer students get $1,500-$5,000 a year by GPA (2.75+). No published international freshman award schedule was found; ask msu.intl@murraystate.edu.

cost.notes: International costs page, bachelor's degree, one academic year: tuition and fees combined $15,990, housing and meals $12,484, books and insurance $2,232, total $30,706 (this is also the bank-balance requirement). The page does not print the academic year; its transfer scholarship table is labelled 2026-27
